newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Goldtron unit sells Malaysian equity.
newsitem.headline: Goldtron unit sells Malaysian equity.

text.p: Goldtron Ltd said on Thursday its wholly owned subsidiary Nacomat Pte Ltd had sold its 45.5 percent interest in a Malaysian-based company.
The sale is in line with Goldtron's aim to concentrate on its core businesses, mainly manufacturing telecommunications products, surface mount assemblies and electronics.
The company's unit Nacomat agreed to sell its stake in Prime Granite (Malaysia) Sdn Bhd (PGM) to Abdullah Bin Seplen and Le Ching Tai for Malaysian 10.7 million ringgit, Goldtron said in a statement.
PGM manufactures polished granite, marble slabs, tiles and other related products and provides contract services.
Goldtron said the sale had no material impact on the profits and net assets of the group based on the accounts of the company for the year ended December 31, 1996.
